harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent, filesystem-enforced 100 MiB XFS project quota for datauser under /srv/data. Allowed writes succeed below the limit and over-limit writes fail with ENOSPC. The configuration survived the mandatory node restart; RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0 remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the locked datauser account and /srv/data with datauser ownership and mode 0750.
Enabled persistent XFS project quotas through the supported rootflags=pquota boot argument.
Mapped /srv/data to project dataquota and configured 100 MiB soft and hard limits.
Verified a 99 MiB write succeeds and crossing 100 MiB fails with No space left on device.
Removed test artifacts and restored the original /etc/fstab byte-for-byte.
Restarted node1 safely, proved its boot identity changed, and repeated the quota boundary test successfully after recovery.
Confirmed SSH active, zero failed units, empty /srv/data, and unchanged OS/kernel.

evidence.summary: Shows XFS project accounting and enforcement ON, 100 MiB soft/hard limits, a successful 99 MiB write, and an over-limit write denied with ENOSPC.

evidence.requirement: Persistent configuration, cleanup, and platform preservation
evidence.summary: Shows the original and restored fstab checksum, persistent rootflags=pquota, cleaned test data, and unchanged RHEL release and kernel.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 1ee75bda-6034-4d39-b227-c852949e9c2f, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 6e938466-cb2d-4ae2-b242-35f2cb0fbf3a, and recovered quota enforcement, account, SSH, data, and post-restart boundary behavior.
